changelog: ⚡ Instant Zero-Debounce Real-Time Sync: Interactive actions including timer pause/resume, task completion checks, and session state now broadcast lightweight inline delta packets immediately (0ms debounce)
⏱️ Dynamic Timer Reactivity & Frozen Timestamps: Pausing or resuming a timer on one device instantly pauses or resumes the timer on all paired devices with exact timestamp synchronization
🛡️ Parallel Relay Fan-Out & Split-Brain Elimination: Outgoing relay messages are transmitted across all healthy relays simultaneously, eliminating split-brain communication issues
🔄 Automatic WebRTC Upgrade on Reconnect: Devices automatically negotiate direct WebRTC DataChannels over Google STUN upon reconnecting or launching
🎯 Strict Single-Running-Session Sanitization: Enforces that at most one active timer session can run at any time, preventing ghost timers or conflicting active sessions across devices
